g.text: I2C: FireBeetle is the only master (3.3 V). Fit one set of 4.7 kOhm pull-ups only.

g.desc: I2C: FireBeetle is the only master (3.3 V). Fit one set of 4.7 kOhm pull-ups only.

g.text: Same net label = connected. This is a net-label schematic, not a routed harness.

g.desc: Same net label = connected. This is a net-label schematic, not a routed harness.

g.text: CHG_VBUS: solar and crank share the one sealed port. BATT_4S: 4x21700 series, fuse positive.

g.desc: CHG_VBUS: solar and crank share the one sealed port. BATT_4S: 4x21700 series, fuse positive.

g.text: USB_FB_SERIAL: FireBeetle USB-C to Pi USB-A, data-only preferred. Trackball is r2-only; r3 uses none.

g.desc: USB_FB_SERIAL: FireBeetle USB-C to Pi USB-A, data-only preferred. Trackball is r2-only; r3 uses none.

g.text: R3 keyboard: the case holds only the Phistone 2.4G dongle (J10) in a Pi USB-A port. Bluetooth option: no dongle, no wire.
